risk_notes: Deploy, IAM, AWS role, and EventBridge production mutation are gated. Run dry-run/validation first, then execute only where repo automation or existing permissions explicitly permit.
No deletion. Archive-only for superseded files.
Secrets must be GitHub Actions secrets or OIDC role assumptions; do not commit credentials.

files_to_apply.content:
name: Deploy bridge invoke handler

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'handler.mjs'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-bridge-handler.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: bridge-invoke-handler-deploy
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  AWS_REGION: ap-southeast-2
  FUNCTION_NAME: mcp-bridge-invoke-handler

jobs:
  validate-package-deploy-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; else npm init -y && npm install @aws-sdk/client-lambda; fi

      - name: Syntax check
        run: node --check handler.mjs

      - name: Package Lambda artifact
        run: |
          rm -rf dist bridge-handler.zip
          mkdir -p dist
          cp handler.mjs dist/handler.mjs
          if [ -d node_modules ]; then cp -R node_modules dist/node_modules; fi
          if [ -f package.json ]; then cp package.json dist/package.json; fi
          cd dist && zip -qr ../bridge-handler.zip .

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        if: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME != '' }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Dry-run AWS identity
        if: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME != '' }}
        run: aws sts get-caller-identity

      - name: Deploy Lambda code
        if: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME != '' }}
        run: |
          aws lambda update-function-code \
            --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME" \
            --zip-file fileb://bridge-handler.zip
          aws lambda wait function-updated --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME"
          aws lambda update-function-configuration \
            --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME" \
            --runtime nodejs20.x \
            --handler handler.handler
          aws lambda wait function-updated --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME"

      - name: Smoke invoke health path
        if: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME != '' }}
        run: |
          aws lambda invoke \
            --function-name "$FUNCTION_NAME" \
            --payload '{"requestContext":{"http":{"method":"GET"}}}' \
            --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out \
            smoke-response.json
          cat smoke-response.json
          grep -q '"ok":true' smoke-response.json

      - name: Write local receipt artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p receipts/runtime
          cat > receipts/runtime/bridge-handler-deploy.receipt.json <<JSON
          {
            "idempotency_key": "bridge-rebuild-handler-autodeploy-2026-04-29-001",
            "workflow": "deploy-bridge-handler",
            "evidence_state": "REAL_IF_WORKFLOW_GREEN_PARTIAL_IF_DRY_ONLY",
            "function_name": "$FUNCTION_NAME",
            "runtime": "nodejs20.x",
            "commit": "${GITHUB_SHA}",
            "run_id": "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}",
            "created_at": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          }
          JSON
          cat receipts/runtime/bridge-handler-deploy.receipt.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bridge-handler-deploy-receipt
          path: receipts/runtime/bridge-handler-deploy.receipt.json

verification_plan: Repo exists and default branch resolves.
Workflow packages bridge-handler.zip without secrets committed.
If AWS_ROLE_TO_ASSUME exists, workflow deploys Lambda, waits for update, invokes GET health path, and uploads receipt artifact.
